---
title: "Prelude"
subtitle: "What to do before you come to the Pre-Conference Workshop"
---

Everything on this page is designed to be done **on your own laptop, before
the workshop**.

::: {.callout-important}
## The one thing that must be done
Install R, RStudio and Quarto, and run the setup check. If your laptop is not
ready on the morning of workshop, you will miss out on many concepts and will spend most of your time playing catch-up! So, ensure you do this before you come for the workshop.
:::

## Checklist

| | Task | Time | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| ☐ | Install R, RStudio, Quarto | 30 min | [Install the software](install.qmd) |
| ☐ | Install workshop packages and run the check script | 15 min | [Check your setup](check-setup.qmd) |
| ☐ | Work through the self-paced R primer | 45 min | [R primer](r-primer.qmd) |
| ☐ | Go through the pre-reading | 20 min | [Pre-reading](pre-reading.qmd) |
| ☐ | Upload your setup-check output, so we know your laptop is ready | 2 min | *Moodle Course* |
| ☐ | Complete the online pre-test | 10 min | *Moodle Course* |

The [**Moodle Course**](https://setfacilitysaral2.org/course/view.php?id=394) contains five short check quizzes and a help-desk forum.


## What to bring

- A laptop in good working condition. Windows, macOS and Linux are all fine. Preferably 16 GB RAM.
- A charger. Power outlets are limited; arrive fully-charged.
- The toolsets installed. R, RStudio and Quarto.


## What you do *not* need

- Prior programming experience of any kind.
- Statistics beyond what you already use in your own research.
- A paid licence for anything. Every tool in this workshop is free and
  open source.

## Why a prelude to the workshop

Two days is a short time. Installation problems, "what is a working directory?", and "why does my file not open?" can eat most of the time we have.

Doing the prelude buys us the time to spend on the more important concepts rather than troubleshooting.

::: {.callout-note}
## Stuck?
Work through [Troubleshooting](../resources/troubleshooting.qmd) first. It
covers the errors that account for most installation failures. If that does
not help, email us (a) your operating system and version,
(b) the exact error message, and (c) the output of `sessionInfo()`.
:::
